scientific_integrity: Analytical identities and unique positive-quadrant optimizer derived from reduced density-matrix ODE, with two independent computational checks. Historical priority remains provisional pending access and independent review.
scientific_limitations: Single excitation, exact star adjacency, uniform uncorrelated pure dephasing and central trap only; no extra decay or disorder. Mean is integrated survival, not 50% absorption quantile. Full text of Gaab–Bardeen 2004 was inaccessible for definitive priority comparison.
title: Exact capture times and jointly optimal dephasing on quantum stars
